commands.commandLine: "C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command 'Copy-Item eza_port.py executable -Force; $ref=(Get-Content -Raw REFERENCE_BINARY.txt).Trim(); $tmp=Join-Path (Get-Location) '"'verify_dir'; if(Test-Path "'$tmp){Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $tmp}; New-Item -ItemType Directory $tmp | Out-Null; Set-Content -NoNewline -Path (Join-Path $tmp '"'b.txt') -Value 'hello'; Set-Content -NoNewline -Path (Join-Path "'$tmp '"'a') -Value 'x'; Set-Content -NoNewline -Path (Join-Path "'$tmp '"'.hidden') -Value 'h'; New-Item -ItemType Directory (Join-Path "'$tmp '"'dir') | Out-Null; Set-Content -NoNewline -Path (Join-Path "'$tmp '"'dir\\z') -Value 'z'; "'$cases=@(@('"'--color=never','--icons=never',"'$tmp),@('"'--color=never','--icons=never','-a','-1',"'$tmp),@('"'--color=never','--icons=never','-T',"'$tmp),@('"'--color=never','--icons=never','-R','-l',"'$tmp),@('"'--color=never','--icons=never','--sort=size','-1',"'$tmp),@('"'--help')); "'$fails=0; foreach($c in $cases){ & $ref @c >r.out 2>r.err; $rs=$LASTEXITCODE; & python ./executable @c >p.out 2>p.err; $ps=$LASTEXITCODE; $sameOut=(([IO.File]::ReadAllBytes((Resolve-Path r.out)) -join '"',') -eq ([IO.File]::ReadAllBytes((Resolve-Path p.out)) -join ',')); "'$sameErr=(([IO.File]::ReadAllBytes((Resolve-Path r.err)) -join '"',') -eq ([IO.File]::ReadAllBytes((Resolve-Path p.err)) -join ',')); if("'$rs -ne $ps -or -not $sameOut -or -not $sameErr){$fails++; "FAIL $($c -join '"' ')\"}}; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force "'$tmp; Remove-Item -Force r.out,r.err,p.out,p.err; "VERIFY_FAILS=$fails"'

"C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command '$ref=(Get-Content -Raw REFERENCE_BINARY.txt).Trim(); $exe=(Resolve-Path executable).Path; $fails=0; $total=0; Get-ChildItem rust-reference'"\\tests\\ptests -Filter *.toml | ForEach-Object { "'$toml=Get-Content -Raw $_.FullName; if($toml -match '"'args = \"(["'^"]*)"'"'){ "'$argline=$Matches[1]; $args = if($argline.Length){ $argline -split '"' ' } else { @() }; "'$rOut=Join-Path $PWD '"'r.out';"'$rErr=Join-Path $PWD '"'r.err';"'$pOut=Join-Path $PWD '"'p.out';"'$pErr=Join-Path $PWD '"'p.err'; Push-Location rust-reference; & "'$ref @args >$rOut 2>$rErr; $rs=$LASTEXITCODE; & python $exe @args >$pOut 2>$pErr; $ps=$LASTEXITCODE; Pop-Location; $ro=[IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($rOut);$po=[IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($pOut);$re=[IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($rErr);$pe=[IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($pErr); $sameOut=(($ro -join '"',') -eq ("'$po -join '"',')); "'$sameErr=(($re -join '"',') -eq ("'$pe -join '"',')); "'$script:total++; if($rs -ne $ps -or -not $sameOut -or -not $sameErr){ $script:fails++; if($script:fails -le 5){"--- FAIL $($_.Name) args=[$argline] status $rs/$ps out=$sameOut err=$sameErr"} } } }; Remove-Item -Force r.out,r.err,p.out,p.err -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; "TOTAL=$total FAILS=$fails"; git status --short'
